subject: Request: Early termination + proposed offboarding protections
messages:
From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@greencrest.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Greencrest Health Legal <legal@greencrest.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Early termination + offboarding timeline

Sean / Marissa —

Thanks again for the implementation support over the last quarter. Unfortunately we are facing a healthcare funding reallocation and need to discuss exiting our Redwood pilot earlier than planned. We want to understand options for an orderly offboarding and what, if any, flexibility exists for the remaining committed ramp period.

High level ask: can we unwind the remaining 6 months of committed capacity with a graduated credit or partial refund and a short transition period so our integrations can be shut down without disruption?

What we can offer in return: a public case study reference once the program is complete and a short extension for your team to ship a final audit package.

Attached: termination_request (GC_termination_request.pdf)

Best,
Jordan Lee
VP, Product Operations
Greencrest Health

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@greencrest.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Early termination + offboarding timeline

Jordan — thanks for the note and for flagging this early. I’m sorry to hear about the funding pressure. We’re committed to making offboarding low-friction where possible.

High-level proposal from Redwood to get this moving quickly:
- 90-day transition window to wind down integrations (we provide export & runbook support).
- Graduated credit over remaining committed period: 50% credit for months 1–2, 25% credit for months 3–6. Total blended credit = 35% of remaining committed value.
- One-time offboarding fee to cover reserved capacity release: $12,500.
- Opt-out language: customer retains right to resume paid service within the 90-day window at prior terms; beyond window, new commercial terms apply.

I’ll need deal desk sign-off on the credit schedule and finance approval on the offboarding fee. Karthik / Monica — can you weigh in quickly? Jordan — I’ve attached a proposed amendment redline for your legal team to review.

Attachments: proposed_amendment_redline.docx

Next step: if internal OK, we can send a short mutually agreed amendment and DocuSign link by EOD tomorrow.

- Sean
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Early termination + offboarding timeline

Sean — quick read-through and initial comments from Legal & Finance:

Legal (high level):
- The opt-out/resume language is acceptable with one tweak — add a clause limiting re-activation pricing protection to 60 days (vs 90) to avoid open-ended legacy pricing exposure.
- Require confirmation that Greencrest will delete PII from test systems within the 90-day window and provide an export manifest. Add that to the amendment.

Finance:
- Monica ran the numbers. Given the remaining committed ARR (~$420k) the proposed blended credit (~35%) would be a $147k credit. Treasury prefers to cap the carry-forward credit to $120k and treat the remainder as a discount tied to early termination (accounting will need to mark this as contra-revenue).
- Suggest splitting the offboarding fee into two line items for clarity: capacity release fee $10k + operational exit support $2.5k.

Summary recommendation: approve a capped credit of $120k, 60-day re-activation pricing protection, 90-day operational window for exports, and split offboarding fee. Once Monica confirms the numbers in the schedule, Legal will finalize the redline and we can get exec sign-off.

— Karthik
Head of Deal Desk (Contracts & Risk)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@greencrest.com>, Greencrest Health Legal <legal@greencrest.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2025 15:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Early termination + offboarding timeline — approval and final terms

Jordan — thanks for your patience while we reviewed this internally. We appreciate Greencrest’s constructive offer (especially the case study commitment). After aligning Legal and Finance, Redwood is willing to accept an early termination with the following confirmed terms:

1) Transition window: 90 calendar days for operational wind-down and export; Redwood will provide a runbook and migration assistance.
2) Credit schedule: consolidated cap at $120,000 applied as a credit against the remaining committed invoices. This represents the commercial concession approved by Revenue Ops.
3) Offboarding fees: capacity release fee $10,000 + exit support $2,500 (total $12,500).
4) Re-activation / opt-out protection: Pricing protection for re-activation limited to 60 days from effective termination date. If Greencrest resumes within 60 days, Redwood will honor prior per-unit pricing for that 60-day window only.
5) Data handling: Greencrest must confirm deletion of PII from test environments and sign the export manifest within the 90-day window. Redwood will provide the manifest template.

I’ve attached the final redline reflecting the changes (see proposed_amendment_redline.docx) and an offboarding credit schedule (offboarding_credit_schedule.xlsx). If these are acceptable, please sign the amendment via DocuSign link and we’ll process the credit against the next invoice cycle.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.net/greencrest/EN/12345-approval
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/5421/GN-4721

Jordan — happy to hop on a quick call if you want to walk the schedule together this afternoon.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
